name: Miniamin
overview: Miniamin is identified in Scripture as a Levite who played a key role in the distribution of sacred offerings during King Hezekiah's reign, demonstrating faithful service in the priestly duties (2 Chronicles 31:15). Additionally, Miniamin is listed among the priests who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel, indicating his participation in the restoration of worship after the exile (Nehemiah 12:17, 12:41). These references highlight Miniamin's continual commitment to the temple ministry both in times of reform and restoration.
